title: 【虚空遗物+事件更新】霜誓者 Frostsworn｜冰霜法师与日食挑战
changeNote:
0.9.10 正式版联机开局黑屏与调试召唤保护 / Stable multiplayer startup and debug-summon safeguards
仅 public / 游戏0.107.1。副机实际日志确认：SyncRngMessage 读取共享遗物池时模型编号越界，导致开局停留黑屏。该快照改为 FSR2：保留正式版种子、全部 RNG 计数器与完整遗物名称、稀有度和顺序，不再依赖双方编号表位宽；未知遗物和异常包会明确拒绝，不丢弃遗物、不跳过原版校验。协议 Hash 写入真实存储，所有玩家必须更新0.9.10并彻底重启，不能混用0.9.9。
针对日志中的 Loadout 调试召唤：普通战场缺少蟹 Boss 专用背景时，提前拒绝 Crusher/Rocket，防止半初始化怪物受伤回调报错，继而中断出牌、卡牌留在屏幕中央。只限制该不受支持的调试召唤，不改变正常 Boss 战，不强行吞掉出牌异常。
移除误放在 content 内的 release-target.json，改用 TXT。追加不同编号表/11-12-13位宽、真实Init Hash、异常包拒绝、调试召唤后实际出牌及发布目录扫描回归。真实两台电脑仍请更新后复测。
Public / game 0.107.1 only. Fixes the confirmed client failure decoding shared relic IDs in SyncRngMessage. FSR2 preserves the stable seed, all RNG counters, full relic names, rarities and order independently of peer ID-table size/bit width. Unknown gameplay relics and malformed packets are rejected, not dropped. The actual stored protocol hash is finalized consistently. ALL peers must update to 0.9.10 and fully restart; do not mix with 0.9.9.
Prevents unsupported Loadout debug summons of Crusher/Rocket without the Kaiser Crab background before they leave broken creatures that interrupt card resolution. Normal boss encounters are unchanged. Removes auxiliary JSON from published content. Tested divergent ID tables, packet validation, real hash initialization, post-rejection native card completion and recursive package scanning. Two-PC confirmation remains required.
